subject: english
stem: Leo boards the 21:40 last bus. What payment condition must he meet?
options: He must pay with a credit card.
He may ask for change on the bus.
He must take the delayed River bus instead.
He must have the exact fare.

optionRationales.reason: He must pay with a credit card.：頁面未提供此方式。
He may ask for change on the bus.：與 exact fare only 相反。
He must take the delayed River bus instead.：不是 last bus 的付款條件。
He must have the exact fare.：21:40 是 LAST BUS，附註規定只收 exact fare。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「主表或圖表提供的數值與 NOTE 限制同時套用後只剩一個可行方案」可推出 He must have the exact fare.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 He must have the exact fare. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
